title: PIDSS Simulation Result Schema
description: Output schema for the C++ Simulator CLI (Pidss.Simulation). Written to artifacts/{run_id}/simulation_result.json. Consumed by Python Analytics CLI as input.

run_id.description: UUID v4 of the run that produced this artifact.

simulator_version.description: PIDSS-Simulator version string (e.g., 1.0.0). Recorded in artifact_manifest.json.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this file was written.

throughput.description: Quality-adjusted good units completed per hour (after defect/scrap deduction). System-level output rate.

lead_time_estimate.description: Estimated flow time in hours via Little's Law: total_wip / throughput.

total_wip.description: Aggregate WIP units across all stage boundaries.

wip_per_stage.description: Average WIP units at each stage boundary. Keys are stage_ids. For integrated WorkUnits, values are attributed via pre-materialized stage_weights.

stage_utilization.description: Fraction of available time actively processing per stage (0.0–1.0). Keys are stage_ids.

blocking_time.description: Cumulative time (seconds) a stage was blocked — unable to transfer output downstream. Keys are stage_ids.

starvation_time.description: Cumulative time (seconds) a stage was starved — no input available from upstream. Keys are stage_ids.

defect_units_per_stage.description: Total defective units generated per stage over the simulation period. Keys are stage_ids.

rework_units_per_stage.description: Total units sent to rework per stage. Keys are stage_ids.

scrap_units_per_stage.description: Total units scrapped (defects that could not be reworked) per stage. Keys are stage_ids.

effective_availability.description: Effective availability per work unit, computed from MTBF/MTTR: mtbf / (mtbf + mttr/60). Keys are work_unit_ids. Units without reliability data have availability = 1.0.

effective_oee.description: Effective OEE per work unit: availability × operating_rate × (1 - defect_rate). Keys are work_unit_ids.

machine_area_m2.description: Total floor area of all WorkUnit instances: Σ(count × model.footprint_m2).

wip_area_m2.description: Total floor area of WIP buffers: Σ(wip_per_stage × model.unit_buffer_area_m2).
